name: Hano
source: Hano is the manager of Arcade Tank. She is also a famous gamer named DRILL(resembling the shape of her permed side ponytail), who is famous for establishing unbeatable high scores across a wide range of gaming systems. Her speech and her actions resemble a man. She is passionate about gaming and competition. However, because she believes that going easy against an opponent is disrespectful, she will always plays to the best of her ability. She is known for having a devilish and playful personality. Hano is also unable to abandon anyone who is in trouble, and always eager to lend a helping hand. Everyone at the arcade sees her as a reliable big sister.
